rationale: ll-queue is a local single-writer-SQLite queue matching every non-jittered backoff precedent in the codebase (transport.py webhook/fan-in, git_lock.py); the sole jittered site targets an external distributed retry. The concurrent-drainer race jitter would mitigate is already closed by claim_entry's BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and the busy_timeout pragma.
alternatives_rejected: Jittered exponential backoff (Option B), following fsm/executor.py's external rate-limit retry convention
